name: Jitbit Helpdesk
description_en:
Jitbit Helpdesk is an email-first ticket system for IT support and customer service, offered as SaaS or a self-hosted .NET/SQL Server application. Requests from mail, portal and other configured channels become tickets with categories, ownership, private notes, knowledge and automation. Self-hosted deployment now includes Windows, Linux and Docker choices in the current manual.

Evaluation should trace message delivery and access, rule-trigger chains, AI actions and a usable export. The price differs between hosted seat bundles, a perpetual on-premises license and a separately licensed self-hosted AI service. Public documentation was researched; no mailbox, account, deployment, AI call or restore was tested.
description_zh:
Jitbit Helpdesk 是面向IT支持及客户服务的邮件优先工单系统，可选SaaS或自托管.NET／SQL Server应用。邮件、门户及其他已配置渠道请求形成带分类、负责人、私有备注、知识和自动化的工单。当前手册的自托管方案包含Windows、Linux及Docker。

评估应追踪消息投递与访问、规则触发链、AI动作及可用导出。托管席位包、永久本地许可、单独授权的自托管AI服务各有价格。本文研究公开文档，未测试邮箱、账户、部署、AI调用或恢复。

faq.question_en: Does a perpetual license include lifetime updates?
faq.question_zh: 永久许可包含终身更新吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The existing version continues, while updates and support are included for twelve months and then renew separately.
faq.answer_zh: 不包含，已有版本继续运行，更新及支持包含12个月，此后单独续约。

faq.question_en: Are local embeddings the same as entirely local AI?
faq.question_zh: 本地嵌入就代表AI完全本地吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The add-on supports local embeddings, but generated reply drafts can still call an external model using your provider key.
faq.answer_zh: 不是，附加服务支持本地嵌入，但生成回复草稿仍可能使用自身密钥调用外部模型。

sections.title_en: Match deployment to a real operations owner
sections.title_zh: 让部署方式对应真实运维负责人
sections.en:
Jitbit offers hosted ticketing and a self-hosted.NET/SQL Server application. Its current manual covers Windows, Linux and Docker and distinguishes requesters, company managers, category-authorized technicians and administrators. Administrator status alone does not mean new-ticket notification in every category.

For an illustrative internal access request, establish who can see that category and who receives assignment notices. Self-hosting also entails database operations, service startup, updates and recovery; a perpetual purchase does not perform them. The installation guide warns about initial default credentials and upgrade impacts on custom source changes. No install commands or supplied example credentials were used here.
sections.zh:
Jitbit提供托管工单及自托管.NET／SQL Server应用。当前手册涵盖Windows、Linux和Docker，并区分请求人、公司经理、获分类授权的技术人员及管理员。管理员身份本身不表示会收到每个分类的新工单通知。

以假设内部访问申请为例，应确定谁能看分类、谁接收分配通知。自托管还包含数据库运维、服务启动、更新及恢复，购买永久许可不会完成这些工作。安装指南警告初始默认凭据及升级对自定义源码的影响。此次未运行安装命令或使用示例凭据。

sections.title_en: Separate a healthy inbox page from healthy mail ingestion
sections.title_zh: 区分收件页面正常与邮件接入正常
sections.en:
The mail guide describes one-to-five-minute polling and may temporarily disable a mailbox after five consecutive connection errors. It also documents SaaS forwarding to the built-in support address. These are distinct intake paths, so a visible portal and an empty queue do not establish delivery success.

Threading uses the ticket number in the subject and can fall back to message-reference headers. Subscribers and notification choices determine who receives updates. Customer autologin links last three days and can expose access when forwarded. Individual custom-field masks may include non-public fields even though the general field list excludes them. Test intended recipients, private fields, forwarded notices and reply threading before adopting a production mailbox.
sections.zh:
邮件指南描述1至5分钟轮询，并可能在连续5次连接错误后暂时禁用邮箱，也说明SaaS可转发至内置支持地址。这是不同接入链路，因此门户可见或队列为空不能证明投递成功。

串联使用主题中的工单号，也可回退检查邮件引用头。订阅者及通知选项决定谁接收更新。客户自动登录链接有效3天，转发后可能暴露访问；单独自定义字段占位符即使在通用字段列表排除私有字段时，仍可能包含非公开内容。接入生产邮箱前应测试预期收件人、私有字段、转发通知和回复串联。

sections.title_en: Treat automation as an event chain
sections.en:
Rules have triggers, conditions and actions, execute in displayed order and can stop subsequent rules. A category-changing action fires category-change rules; loop protection is documented but is not proof that a complex chain is harmless. Time-based triggers run once per ticket under the guide’s described behavior. Approval-granted triggers do not fire on rejection.

AI triage is asynchronous: other rules continue while category, priority and sentiment are computed. If routing depends on the result, use the documented sentiment-detected event rather than assuming the next creation rule sees a completed AI call. Keep an initial pilot narrow and inspect repeated replies, changed due dates and public-message actions. This research did not execute any chain.
sections.zh:
规则有触发器、条件和动作，按显示顺序执行，可终止后续规则。修改分类的动作会触发分类变更规则；虽有循环保护说明，也不能证明复杂链无害。文档所述时间触发器每工单运行一次，批准事件不会因拒绝而触发。

AI分诊为异步：计算分类、优先级和情绪时，其他规则继续。若路由依赖该结果，应使用文档中的情绪检测完成事件，而非假定下一条创建规则看到已完成AI调用。首轮试点应窄，检查重复回复、到期日变化及公开消息动作。本研究未执行任何链。

sections.title_en: Distinguish reviewed drafts from automatic actions
sections.title_zh: 区分审阅草稿与自动动作
sections.en:
Manual AI reply generation lets a technician insert or edit the draft before sending. The automation action instead posts a generated comment, with a technicians-only option that changes its audience. External tools can call configured HTTP APIs, so a reply feature is not universally a read-only assistant. Errors reaching the model do not establish automatic retry or rollback.

The newer self-hosted AI add-on requires11.22 or later and runs an AI service plus Qdrant. Local embeddings keep that embedding step local; OpenAI embeddings send text externally, and generative replies use a provider key. Its new indexing support supersedes older hosted-only wording for eligible installs. Confirm credentials, endpoint authority, provider billing and the installed add-on before accepting a blanket data-isolation claim.
sections.zh:
手动AI回复生成允许技术人员发送前插入或编辑草稿；自动化动作则发布生成评论，“仅技术人员”选项会改变受众。外部工具可调用已配置HTTP API，因此回复功能并非普遍只读助手。错误传给模型不表示有自动重试或回滚。

较新自托管AI附加服务需11.22及以上，并运行AI服务和Qdrant。本地嵌入使该嵌入步骤留在本地；OpenAI嵌入会外发文字，生成回复则使用服务商密钥。其新索引支持对符合条件安装取代旧托管专属表述。接受全面数据隔离声明前，应确认凭据、端点权限、服务商计费及所装附加服务。

sections.title_en: Keep recurring bundles and perpetual rights separate
sections.title_zh: 分开比较订阅包与永久权利
sections.en:
Hosted monthly plans are$29/$69/$129/$249 for one/four/seven/nine agents. Annual monthly equivalents are$24.92/$58.25/$108.25/$208.25. Enterprise displays$29 per extra agent; the precise annual add-seat calculation should be quoted. Unlimited AI credits appear from Startup, not on the Freelancer card.

The default self-hosted selector shows ten agents at$2,490 once with twelve months of updates/support. Continued use is perpetual, while timely renewal costs fifty percent of the current plan price, rising to eighty percent after the stated sixty-day grace period. The$999 self-hosted AI add-on is separate, as are external provider usage and infrastructure. A separately quoted source-code license is not public open-source permission. Currency code and other slider prices were not established.
sections.zh:
托管月套餐为$29／$69／$129／$249，分别含1／4／7／9坐席；年付折月$24.92／$58.25／$108.25／$208.25。Enterprise显示额外坐席$29，准确年付加席计算需报价。无限AI积分从Startup起列出，Freelancer卡未列。

自托管默认选择器显示10坐席一次$2,490，含12个月更新／支持。继续使用为永久，及时续约为现价50%，超过规定60天宽限后为80%。自托管AI附加$999另计，外部服务商用量及基础设施也另计。单独询价源码许可不等于公开开源授权。币种代码及其他滑块价格未确认。

sections.title_en: Demonstrate an export that can actually be restored
sections.title_zh: 演示确实能恢复的导出
sections.en:
The downloadable backup offer is included from Company upward and can be added to lower plans for a fee. Support first enables a publishing job; fresh downloads appear daily or weekly depending on the plan. This customer-download cadence differs from the more frequent infrastructure backups advertised on the same page.

The documented artifact is a zipped SQL Server database backup, with SQL Server2022 or later required for restore. The vendor lists tickets, replies, accounts, knowledge, fields and linked attachments, but no restore was performed here. Check actual attachment availability, backup age, database size/edition constraints and compatible application licensing before treating the export as a complete exit. Hosted terms also make cancellation and refund timing separate questions.
sections.zh:
可下载备份从Company起包含，低档可付费加购。支持先启用发布任务，再按套餐每日或每周提供新下载。面向客户的下载频率与同页宣传的更频繁基础设施备份不同。

文档产物为压缩SQL Server数据库备份，恢复需SQL Server2022及以上。厂商列工单、回复、账户、知识、字段及关联附件，但此次未执行恢复。将导出视为完整退出方案前，应检查真实附件可用性、备份时间、数据库大小／版本约束及兼容应用许可。托管条款还分别规定取消与退款时间。
